description:
Which calendar quarter and New Zealand tax-year quarter a date is in.

    Use for: 'what quarter is august in', 'quarter dates 2026', 'q3 start and end
    date', 'nz tax year quarters', 'which quarter of the financial year nz',
    'when does q4 end'.

    Calendar Q1 1 January to 31 March, Q2 1 April to 30 June, Q3 1 July to
    30 September, Q4 1 October to 31 December. The NZ tax year runs 1 April to
    31 March, so 15 August 2026 is calendar Q3 and tax-year Q2 of 2026/27.

    Args:
        date: YYYY-MM-DD; omitted, today in New Zealand.
        fiscal_year_start_month: Optional 1 to 12 for another financial year.

    Returns:
        Each quarter's label, start and end, days, and all four quarters of the year.
name: nz_quarter_dates_calculator
